tenderSchedule.title: Selection of an Agency for Centralised Printing, Enveloping, Address Printing/Affixing and Handover of Government Certificates and Documents to India Post for Dispatch under Seva One
tenderSchedule.description: Selection of an Agency for Centralised Printing, Enveloping, Address Printing/Affixing and Handover of Government Certificates and Documents to India Post for Dispatch under Seva One
tenderSchedule.locationName: Directorate of Electronic Delivery of Citizen Services (EDCS) Office Bangalore

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Directorate of EDCS, BWSSB- Suvarna Bhavana, 3 rd floor, 18th cross malleswaram, Bagalore - 55

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall be an empanelled vendor with UIDAI or having an agreement for providing services to UIDAI either in the past or present continuing assignment

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Valid necessary document shall be provided

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder must have successfully completed OR completed part of the ongoing variable data printing projects during last Three years awarded by Government or PSUs or Banks or Autonomous Bodies of the following values as on 31.3.2026 a.One project costing not less than Rs 5 Crore Or b.Two projects costing not less than Rs 3 Crore each Or c. Three projects costing not less than Rs 2 crore each.
The Bidder should have an installed capacity of not less than one lakh per day in variable data printing, enveloping and handling similar Letters related activities.
The bidder shall have printing facility approved by RBI/IBA

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant certificate shall be submitted

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall have own printing facility within Karnataka.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Factory License shall be submitted

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidders Average Annual Turnover should be at least Rs 50 Crore (Rupees Fifty Crore) from the core printing operation within India only, during the previous three financial years (2023-2024, 2024-2025 & 2025-26).
Should have filed income tax returns for the past three financial years (2023-2024, 2024-2025 & 2025-26).
The bidder shall not be insolvent or undergoing liquidation in a manner that materially affects its ability to perform the contract.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Self-declaration and other documents specified in the tender

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall have a positive net worth during the past three preceding years (2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- CA Certified Balance sheet or net worth statement

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall be a legally constituted company, LLP, registered partnership firm or other entity permitted to participate under the applicable procurement rules.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Certificate of incorporation, registration certificate or equivalent legal document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall possess a valid PAN.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- PAN card or relevant official registration document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall possess GST registration, wherever applicable.
The bidder shall not be blacklisted or debarred by a government department, government agency or public-sector entity as on the date of submission, subject to applicable law.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Self-declaration in the prescribed format

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall agree to comply with confidentiality, data protection, information security and document-handling requirements.
The bidder should have the following certifications, valid at the time of bid submission, ISO 27001 2022, ISO 9001: 2015, ISO 20000-1:2018

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Copy of the certification valid on date of bid submission.

itemList.itemName: Sorting, preparation of dispatch manifest and handover to designated India Post office (1 quantity)
Printing or affixing of recipient address and return address (1 quantity)
Provision of envelope, insertion, sealing and packaging (tamper-evident packaging) (1 quantity)
Printing of government documents, including ordinary printing consumables per page (one side)
